plugins.//: arm64 ONLY. The universal APK was 82 MB because it carried four ABIs; every modern Android phone is arm64-v8a, so the other three were dead weight in a download a judge has to accept an 'unknown source' warning for. buildArchs overrides reactNativeArchitectures in gradle.properties. COST, stated plainly: this drops pre-2015 32-bit devices (armeabi-v7a) and Android emulators on x86/x86_64 hosts - an emulator needs a build without this filter. Runtime behaviour is unchanged: the JS bundle is identical and arm64 is the slice that already executed on real hardware.
